title: Harassment ga Kowai Maki-senpai!
titleNative: ハラスメントが怖いマキ先輩！
synonyms: Maki Senpai is afraid of harassment!
synopsis: The editor-in-chief, Maki Ishikawa, is kind to co-workers, good at her job, and acts like the ideal boss! But in front of her junior colleague, Nodoka Minami, she starts acting strangely. "Maki-senpai, I can always count on you!" Minami says with a big smile. Maki wants to get to know Minami better, but she is worried, "Would it be harassment to ask for her phone number?" “Is it be too much if I ask her out to lunch?" she wonders… Aah!!! She definitely doesn't want come across like a creep, but she wishes they could be be friends! (Source: forcs, translated)

title: Shujinkou-sama no Imouto ni Aisarete Irukedo, Shikkari Yandere.
titleRomaji: Shujinkou-sama no Imouto ni Aisarete Irukedo, Shikkari Yandere.
titleNative: 主人公様の妹に愛されているけど、しっかりヤンデレ。
synopsis: High school boy Shinji Usui has a childhood friend named Hinata Ichinose — a guy who’s handsome and incredibly popular with girls, just like the hero of a rom-com. Being around Hinata, who’s as radiant and captivating as the sun, made Shinji feel pitiful by comparison, so at some point, he began to feel a bit uncomfortable around him. On the other hand, Hinata’s younger sister, Tsukina, treats him more kindly than she treats her own brother, for some reason. The story begins when Shinji — who has been trying to come to terms with these complex feelings — receives an ominously worded love letter. (Source: Natalie, translated)

titleRomaji: Watashi no Shiranai, Senpai no Hyakko no Koto
titleNative: わたしの知らない、先輩の100コのこと
synopsis: A senpai and his kouhai had no contact in the past except for using the same train station to go to school, thus only meeting each other in the morning. One day, they made a promise: "A single question each day, and answer it honestly." "I want to know more about Senpai, and I would like to know what I don't know about Senpai. So let's ask each other one question a day—for a total of 100 questions." This is the story of two people who are slowly getting closer, one question a day. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yueguo Chenshi de Ge
synonyms: The Song That Transcends This World
synopsis: During troubled times, Weng Shaoying is one of the most famous singers in Dongping. Many people go to Song of Fairyland just to see her perform. However, under her glamorous facade, she has been controlled for more than 10 years. On the other side of Dongping is Bi Xing Tang, one of the most famous gangs there. After her father’s death, Yanchu became the young female leader of Bi Xing Tang, which caused a lot of rumors to spread. On one inevitably fortuitous night, the two happened to meet. At that time, neither of them knew that they would eventually become the most important person in the other’s life. Starting from that night onwards, the gears in Shaoying and Yanchu’s fate will forever be rotating together. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Hotel Metsäpeura e Youkoso
titleNative: ホテル・メッツァペウラへようこそ
synopsis: In the Lapland region of Finland, the domain of snow, midnight sun, and auroras, there is the small Hotel Metsäpeura, run by two older gentlemen. One night during a terrible blizzard, a mysterious young man named Jun arrives at the hotel. He is clearly in dire straits, with a large tattoo on his back, no relatives and no money. However, the gentlemen warmly welcome him in and offer him a job at the hotel. The kindness of the people living in the harshness of nature will melt the heart of this awkward young man.
